text:
laura: Heads-up: I noticed two issues in /docs/security/audit-logs.md while prepping evidence for SOC2. One, the SQL example returns actor_id for both users and service accounts which is confusing. Two, the Go SDK example link at the bottom 404s after the examples repo restructure. Can someone pick these up?

mike: I can take the SQL change. Looks like the example query doesn't project actor.type. I'll change the example to `SELECT ts, actor_id, actor.type, payload FROM audit_events WHERE actor.type = 'service_principal' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;` and add a short sample JSON row so it's clear.

sophie: Also suggest we reword the retention sentence. Current line "we retain logs for 90 days" reads like a hard policy. Suggest: "Default audit log retention is 90 days; Dedicated and Private customers may configure longer TTLs per contract." Keeps it accurate for SOC2 evidence.

ethan: I'll fix the Go example link. The new path is `github.com/redwood-inference/examples/sdk/go/auditlogs` and the snippet needs to show `client.NewFromEnv()` + `client.Audit.List(ctx, opts)` usage. I'll update the code sample and ensure it uses the current client API.

laura: Thanks. Can we also add a one-line note in docs/migration/audit-log-migration.md to tell teams that previously-used `actor_id` semantics might need updating to `actor.type` filters when migrating queries? A tiny example would help auditors.

mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482. Changes: query example, sample output block, updated retention phrasing, and a migration note. CI running for lint + linkcheck.

docs-bot: Build started for pull request #1482 (mike) 4bb 528.

mike: Linkcheck flagged one internal anchor (docs/migration#query-mapping). I'll patch that in a follow-up commit.

docs-bot: CI passed for pull request #1482 :white_check_mark:.

sophie: Quick review done. Minor wording nit (prefer "Default retention window" rather than "Default retention"). Left a comment.

mike: Fixed Sophie nit, squashed, pushed. Re-running CI locally, all green.

ethan: Updated the Go snippet and pushed a tiny commit to change the import path and example parsing loop. Also added an inline comment noting required env vars for the client.

laura: Merged into main and deployed to staging. Verified the example query on staging returns only service principal rows when using the actor.type filter, and the Go link resolves. I'll capture the updated page screenshot for the SOC2 evidence folder.

mike: Filing a follow-up ticket to add a small automated smoke test for external example links so linkcheck catches moved example repos: DOCS-312.

sophie: I'll add a quick checklist item in the compliance docs checklist to verify wording around retention for Dedicated/Private customers.

laura: Great work—thanks everyone. If auditors ask, reference the migration note and PR #1482.

ethan: If anyone wants the exact sample JSON I used to validate staging, DM me and I'll paste it into the migration notes.
